_doc: Per-route allowlisted noise for scripts/qa-sweep.mjs. Anything not listed is a finding; prune entries that stop appearing. Three channels: 'console' (console/page errors), 'network' (4xx/5xx), 'text' (garbage-text / raw-i18n-key / raw-math probes). A waiver is a claim that the noise is understood — always give a reason.

console.reason: apps/admin ships no favicon, so every admin page logs one 404. Tracked as a polish issue; not worth failing all 66 admin cells. Console entries carry no HTTP status, so this matches on the URL.

recharts ResponsiveContainer logs this on first paint before the container is measured. Verified against docs/qa/screenshots/sweep/admin_dashboard_ADMIN_light-1440.png: every chart renders correctly with real data. Dev-time transient, not a defect — do NOT re-file.

Companion to the global network waiver below — the browser logs every 4xx as a console error too, and a failed-resource entry carries no status, so it must be matched on the URL. Scoped to the /summary/ path: a 404 from any OTHER endpoint still fails.

The YouTube embed's own widget API logs a postMessage target-origin warning from inside the third-party iframe script. Not our code, not actionable from this repo, and it fired on every content route that can host a YouTube source.

console.match: was detected as the Largest Contentful Paint
console.reason: Next.js dev-only warn-once perf HINT (add `priority` to the LCP <Image>), not an error — it never appears in a production build. Logged as O99 so the hint is judged deliberately rather than silently obeyed; whether a list thumbnail is really the LCP element depends on the row, so blanket-adding `priority` could be wrong.

network.reason: Documented empty state, not a failure: a READY content with no summary yet returns 404 {"message":"Summary not found"}, and the client treats it as such — useSavedSummary (apps/web/hooks/useQuiz.ts:218-223) returns null on 404 with retry:false. Oracle-verified R23: content cmrkrfbcv… is status READY with 1 section and GET /summary/<id> → 404 while GET /content/<id> → 200. Fires on every route that mounts the workspace (the page asks for both the full-material and the per-section scope, which is 2 honest 404s, not a duplicate request). Global rather than per-route because the contract is the endpoint's, not the page's.

text.reason: The AI tutor teaches programming and maths, so it renders 'NaN' as correct prose (e.g. 'NaN (Not a Number) tushunchasi'). Everywhere else NaN in the DOM is a real formatting bug, so this waiver is scoped to the tutor route only. Bare 'undefined' is already report-only globally for the same reason.
